items_flat.title_en: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 for demanding technical work
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic釋出Claude Fable 5.2與Mythos 5.2，面向高難度技術工作
items_flat.summary_en: On November 9, Anthropic introduced Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, the same underlying model with stronger safeguards on Fable. The models improve coding, reasoning, and vision, generate outputs up to 30% faster than 5.1 versions, and are priced at $8/$40 per million tokens (fast mode $16/$80). Fable is generally available; Mythos is limited to verified cybersecurity and life-sciences organizations.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月9日，Anthropic推出Claude Fable 5.2與Mythos 5.2，兩者共用底層模型，Fable具備更強防護。模型在編碼、推理與視覺上提升，輸出速度較5.1版本最多快30%，定價為每百萬token $8/$40（快速模式$16/$80）。Fable一般可用，Mythos僅限通過資安與生命科學驗證的組織。
items_flat.analysis_en: The dual-release structure lets Anthropic ship high capability while gating the highest-risk domains. Benchmark gains on agentic coding and science tasks are large relative to 5.1, but real-world reliability outside controlled evaluations remains the key open question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 雙版本設計讓Anthropic在釋出高能力的同時，對高風險領域進行管控。在代理編碼與科學任務的基準提升相對5.1明顯，但受控評估外的真實可靠性仍是關鍵未知。
items_flat.quote: We’ve upgraded Claude Fable and Claude Mythos—models that are designed to tackle the most daunting technical challenges.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們升級了Claude Fable與Claude Mythos——這些模型旨在應對最艱鉅的技術挑戰。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT Wallet for secure agent payments
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出ChatGPT Wallet，實現安全代理支付
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Wallet on November 13, enabling AI agents (dots) to complete purchases without accessing users’ actual card details. Every transaction requires user approval with a security check such as biometrics; initial rollout is limited to US ChatGPT Pro subscribers aged 18+ with eligible US-issued cards, in partnership with American Express, Mastercard, and Visa.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月13日宣布ChatGPT Wallet，讓AI代理（dots）在不接觸用戶真實卡號的情況下完成購買。每筆交易需用戶以生物識別等方式核准；初期僅限美國ChatGPT Pro成年訂戶，並與美國運通、Mastercard與Visa合作。
items_flat.analysis_en: This moves agentic commerce from research demos into a controlled production path that preserves existing card rails and user control. Success still depends on merchant and risk-system adoption; early US-Pro limits leave broader consumer and international uptake uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉將代理商務從實驗推進到受控生產路徑，同時保留既有支付軌道與用戶控制權。成敗仍取決於商家與風控系統配合；初期僅限美國Pro用戶，更廣泛消費者與國際採用仍存不確定。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing ChatGPT Wallet, setting a new bar for secure payments by agents. It’s the first wallet that lets agents pay without access to users’ actual card details and that requires a security check for every purchase.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出ChatGPT Wallet，為代理支付設定新的安全標準。這是首個讓代理在不接觸用戶真實卡號情況下付款、且每筆購買都需安全檢查的錢包。

items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen for faster everyday agentic workflows
items_flat.title_zh: Google推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，加速日常代理工作流
items_flat.summary_en: On November 12, Google DeepMind and Google introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen, positioned as a fast, efficient model for coding and agentic workflows rather than the deepest long-horizon reasoning of Carbon or Argon. It is available across the Gemini API, AI Studio, Gemini for business, the Gemini app, Search, and paid Pro/Ultra tiers in Antigravity, priced flat at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens with a 1M context window.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月12日，Google DeepMind與Google推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，定位為編碼與代理工作流的快速高效模型，而非Carbon或Argon的深度長程推理。已於Gemini API、AI Studio、Gemini for business、Gemini app、Search及付費Pro/Ultra的Antigravity中提供，全上下文統一定價每百萬token $1.50/$7.50，支援1M上下文。
items_flat.analysis_en: Hydrogen broadens Gemini 4 access at a lower price point while claiming speed and efficiency gains over 3.8 Flash. It does not displace the higher-capability Carbon/Argon tier, so the practical division of labor among the three models will depend on developer migration data still to emerge.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Hydrogen以較低價格擴大Gemini 4可及性，並宣稱相對3.8 Flash在速度與效率上有提升。它並未取代更高能力的Carbon/Argon層級，三款模型的實際分工仍取決於後續開發者遷移數據。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，將尖端智能帶給所有人——以速度與效率支援日常編碼與代理工作流。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics 2.5 for improved real-world dexterity
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind推出Gemini Robotics 2.5，提升真實世界靈巧度
items_flat.summary_en: On November 10, Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5, a vision-language-action model that expands task breadth and learning speed. In a Mercedes-Benz proof-of-concept, Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid achieved a reported 96% success rate on automotive parts kitting; the model is rolling out to robotics partners.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月10日，Google DeepMind釋出Gemini Robotics 2.5視覺-語言-動作模型，擴展任務廣度與學習速度。在Mercedes-Benz概念驗證中，Apptronik的Apollo 2人形機器人在汽車零件分揀上據報達96%成功率；模型正推向機器人合作夥伴。
items_flat.analysis_en: The industrial pilot supplies a concrete reliability signal beyond lab benchmarks, yet the 96% figure is vendor-reported on a narrow workflow. Broader generalization and safety in unstructured settings remain to be independently confirmed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 工業試點提供了超越實驗室基準的具體可靠性訊號，但96%數據來自供應商在狹窄工作流的報告。更廣泛的泛化與非結構化環境安全性仍待獨立確認。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are introducing Gemini Robotics 2.5, our most capable vision-language-action (VLA) model to date.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出Gemini Robotics 2.5，迄今最具能力的視覺-語言-動作（VLA）模型。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches roadshow for proposed IPO
items_flat.summary_en: On November 10, Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of Class A common stock. The company had previously filed a Form S-1 with the SEC; the roadshow marks the next formal step toward a public listing.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月10日，Anthropic, PBC啟動其擬議首次公開發行A類普通股的路演。公司先前已向SEC提交S-1表格；路演標誌著邁向公開上市的下一步正式程序。
items_flat.analysis_en: The roadshow advances Anthropic’s transition from private lab to public company while it continues to ship frontier models. Market reception and any conditions attached to the offering will shape how the company balances commercial growth with its public-benefit commitments.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 路演推進Anthropic從私人實驗室轉為上市公司的進程，同時持續釋出前沿模型。市場反應與發行附帶條件將影響公司如何平衡商業成長與其公共利益承諾。
items_flat.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，Anthropic, PBC啟動其擬議首次公開發行A類普通股的路演。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI reorganizes stand-alone robotics team into core research and Applied
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI將獨立機器人團隊重組至核心研究與Applied部門
items_flat.summary_en: On November 13, OpenAI confirmed to Fortune that it has reorganized its stand-alone robotics team. Research staff now report to Chief Research Officer Mark Chen; applied robotics and hardware teams moved under President Greg Brockman’s Applied organization. The company stated robotics remains a core long-term priority and the change is intended to accelerate progress as general-purpose models such as GPT-6 Astra demonstrate direct robot control capability.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月13日，OpenAI向Fortune確認已重組獨立機器人團隊。研究人員改向首席研究官Mark Chen報告；應用與硬體團隊則併入Greg Brockman領導的Applied組織。公司表示機器人仍是長期核心方向，此舉旨在加速進展，因GPT-6 Astra等通用模型已展現直接控制機器人的能力。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move signals a strategic bet that frontier general models can reduce the need for specialized robotics teams, echoing OpenAI’s 2020 pause and 2024 restart. It is not framed as abandonment, yet the absence of a public OpenAI post and the empty CoRL booth leave the exact roadmap and headcount impact opaque.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉顯示OpenAI押注通用前沿模型可減少專用機器人團隊需求，呼應其2020年暫停與2024年重啟。公司未將其描述為放棄，但缺乏公開聲明且CoRL展位空置，具體路線圖與人力影響仍不透明。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind releases PARDIG and SatWeave weather datasets
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind釋出PARDIG與SatWeave天氣數據集
items_flat.summary_en: On November 13, Google DeepMind released two foundational datasets used by WeatherNext 3: SatWeave (a global mosaic of geostationary satellite imagery) and PARDIG (an AI-based global precipitation dataset). Historical archives and live feeds are available on Google Cloud Storage to support research and applications in weather, hydrology, and climate.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月13日，Google DeepMind釋出WeatherNext 3所用的兩項基礎數據集：SatWeave（地球同步衛星影像全球拼圖）與PARDIG（AI全球降水數據集）。歷史存檔與即時饋送已於Google Cloud Storage提供，供天氣、水文與氣候研究與應用使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: Open observational datasets lower the barrier for third parties to build on DeepMind’s weather stack. Independent validation of the claimed precipitation-skill gains will determine how widely the data are adopted outside Google’s own models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 開放觀測數據集降低第三方基於DeepMind天氣技術棧開發的門檻。宣稱的降水技能提升需獨立驗證，才能決定數據在Google自家模型之外的採用廣度。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are releasing two foundational datasets, SatWeave and PARDIG, to support the global community in building weather, hydrology, and climate applications.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們釋出兩項基礎數據集SatWeave與PARDIG，支援全球社群建構天氣、水文與氣候應用。

items_flat.title_en: Meta introduces Muse Ember, a small efficient model for agentic workloads
items_flat.title_zh: Meta推出Muse Ember，面向代理工作負載的小型高效模型
items_flat.summary_en: On November 9, Meta AI announced Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient model to date, built for high-volume agentic tasks such as tool calls, coding subtasks, and long-document parsing. It is available on the Meta Model API at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens, with a 1M context window.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月9日，Meta AI宣布推出Muse Ember，迄今最小且最高效的模型，專為高量代理任務如工具呼叫、編碼子任務與長文件解析設計。已於Meta Model API提供，定價每百萬輸入token $0.10、輸出$0.50，支援1M上下文。
items_flat.analysis_en: Ember extends Meta’s Muse family into a low-cost, high-throughput tier, aiming at the economics of always-on agents. Claims of matching or beating Haiku 5.5 at one-third the cost need independent verification across production workloads.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Ember將Meta的Muse系列延伸至低成本、高通量層級，瞄準常駐代理的經濟性。宣稱以約三分之一成本匹配或超越Haiku 5.5，仍需在生產工作負載上獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: Today we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model yet.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Muse Ember，迄今最小且最高效的模型。

google.analysis_zh: 開放觀測數據集降低第三方基於DeepMind天氣技術棧開發的門檻。宣稱的降水技能提升需獨立驗證，才能決定數據在Google自家模型之外的採用廣度。
google.quote: Today, we are releasing two foundational datasets, SatWeave and PARDIG, to support the global community in building weather, hydrology, and climate applications.
google.quote_zh: 今天，我們釋出兩項基礎數據集SatWeave與PARDIG，支援全球社群建構天氣、水文與氣候應用。

meta.title_en: Meta introduces Muse Ember, a small efficient model for agentic workloads
meta.title_zh: Meta推出Muse Ember，面向代理工作負載的小型高效模型
meta.summary_en: On November 9, Meta AI announced Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient model to date, built for high-volume agentic tasks such as tool calls, coding subtasks, and long-document parsing. It is available on the Meta Model API at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens, with a 1M context window.
meta.summary_zh: 11月9日，Meta AI宣布推出Muse Ember，迄今最小且最高效的模型，專為高量代理任務如工具呼叫、編碼子任務與長文件解析設計。已於Meta Model API提供，定價每百萬輸入token $0.10、輸出$0.50，支援1M上下文。
meta.analysis_en: Ember extends Meta’s Muse family into a low-cost, high-throughput tier, aiming at the economics of always-on agents. Claims of matching or beating Haiku 5.5 at one-third the cost need independent verification across production workloads.
meta.analysis_zh: Ember將Meta的Muse系列延伸至低成本、高通量層級，瞄準常駐代理的經濟性。宣稱以約三分之一成本匹配或超越Haiku 5.5，仍需在生產工作負載上獨立驗證。
meta.quote: Today we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model yet.
meta.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Muse Ember，迄今最小且最高效的模型。

brief_en: OpenAI launches agent payments via ChatGPT Wallet and folds robotics into core research; Anthropic ships Fable/Mythos 5.2 and advances IPO; Google rolls out efficient Gemini 4 Hydrogen plus weather datasets and Robotics 2.5; Meta adds efficient Muse Ember.
brief_zh: OpenAI推出ChatGPT Wallet代理支付並重組機器人團隊；Anthropic釋出Fable/Mythos 5.2並推進IPO；Google推出高效Gemini 4 Hydrogen、天氣數據集與Robotics 2.5；Meta推出高效Muse Ember。
